name: Don't Hit the Dutch Bus
author: croberthyman
description: Driver assignment from Create with Code. Added an additional free asset from the store, the traffic light, with custom light cycling (that I spent... an embarrassing amount of time on). No offense or harm intended to the people of The Netherlands, the title refers to the cinematic framing! Arrow keys to accelerate forward/backward and to turn. Don't hit the bus (Or do; it's kinda hilarious), everything else is fair game.
